shared_elements: low-relief carving worked into a natural stone surface
weathered outdoor stone monument in situ
justification: Both are shallow relief carvings cut into unpolished stone left standing in the open, and each includes rounded eye- or face-like elements set within curving grooves, which is about the limit of the correspondence. A is a tall, flat, pale slab with clearly legible animals and human figures stacked in horizontal registers, whereas B is a cluster of dark rounded boulders bearing sparse, weathered, largely illegible curvilinear designs with no register structure.
